newsitem.title: USA: Coronado in pact with Alcan.
newsitem.headline: Coronado in pact with Alcan.

text.p: Coronado Industries Inc Thursday said its Ophthalmic International signed a confidentiality pact with Alcon Laboratories Inc on the development and marketing of a device for pneumatic trabeculoplasty, a procedure for treating Open Angle Glaucoma.
Glaucoma is one of the leading causes of blindness in the world. It affects 2-1/2 percent of the U.S. population.
Ophthalmic owns a recently patented device and non-invasive treatment method for Glaucoma.
Alcon, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Nestle S.A., is a global leader in the research, development, manufacture and marketing of ophthalmic products.
